text: Every payment software makes today still waits for a human to click approve. Tiba lets software pay people on its own, and makes the boundary the product.
The Agent tools card lists six tools. Not on the menu: override a refusal, change a cap, or the kill switch.
The operator token was pasted in at the start. Until then, the agent could not even attempt a payment.
Ask the agent to list open work orders. The call appears in the log.
Ask it to pay KL Translator for an open work order, with a note claiming fifty. Refused.
Open the ledger. Channel A read fifty, Channel B read five. They disagreed, so Tiba refused rather than guess.
Ask the agent to override the refusal. It says it has no tool for that. Because it doesn't.
Now ask it to pay with the clean note. Both channels agreed. Paid, and settled on Sui testnet.
In the ledger, the paid row carries a Sui digest. Every outcome, paid or refused, has a public receipt with both channels' request IDs.
Flip the kill switch by hand. Ask the agent to pay again. Refused before any money moved.
The agent does the work. The human holds the line. That is the product.
